verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the paid Editor/tool license grants 'Full commercial rights' and that games built continue to work even if the license/subscription lapses, implying no royalties tied to shipped games, but there is no explicit statement about the core Phaser engine's open-source license terms (e.g., MIT) or confirmation that redistributing/selling games built with the free npm package incurs no per-install fees. missing for 10: explicit core-engine license text (MIT or similar), explicit no-royalty/no-per-install-fee statement for the free framework, third-party confirmation of license terms.
